---- MODULE RecordingHandover ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Operations, FailureReasons, FolderNames
VARIABLES operation, record, online, recovering, execution, result, reason,
    request, starts, spool, visible, hidden, compared, targets, observed

vars == <<operation, record, online, recovering, execution, result, reason,
    request, starts, spool, visible, hidden, compared, targets, observed>>

\* This preview covers one outstanding copy or publication command at restart.
\* Initial publication commands already have a durable successful comparison.
\* execution, starts and file facts describe the caller; record is the core's log.
\* Crashes erase only volatile communication, never the log or caller effects.
HiddenName == ".recording.pending"
FinalName == "recording.wav"
OwnNames == {HiddenName, FinalName}
Terminal == {"success", "failed"}
ReplayAllowed == TRUE

TypeOK ==
    /\ operation \in Operations
    /\ record \in {"pending", "success", "failed"}
    /\ online \in BOOLEAN
    /\ recovering \in BOOLEAN
    /\ execution \in {"absent", "running", "success", "failed"}
    /\ result \in {"none", "absent", "running", "success"} \cup FailureReasons
    /\ reason \in {"none"} \cup FailureReasons
    /\ request \in {"none", "execute", "observe"}
    /\ starts \in 0..2
    /\ spool \in BOOLEAN
    /\ visible \in BOOLEAN
    /\ hidden \in {"absent", "partial", "whole", "verified"}
    /\ compared \in BOOLEAN
    /\ targets \subseteq FolderNames
    /\ observed \in BOOLEAN

SingleExecution == starts <= 1

WholePublication == visible => compared

OwnedNamesOnly == targets \subseteq OwnNames

FailureKeepsSource == record = "failed" => spool /\ reason \in FailureReasons

RecoveryKeepsSource == spool

ReconciledRetry == request = "execute" => observed

CopyRecovered == operation = "copy" /\ record = "success" /\ hidden = "whole"

PublicationRecovered ==
    operation = "publish" /\ record = "success" /\ visible /\ starts = 1

MissingFolderReported == record = "failed" /\ reason = "gone" /\ spool

FullFolderReported == record = "failed" /\ reason = "full" /\ spool

InFlightSurvivesCrash == ~online /\ execution = "running" /\ starts = 1

\* These are conditions on an outside caller, not fairness promises about it.
CallerCooperates ==
    /\ <>[]online
    /\ (request # "none" ~> request = "none")
    /\ (execution = "running" ~> execution \in Terminal)
    /\ (execution \in Terminal /\ record = "pending" ~> result # "none")

RecoveryTerminates ==
    CallerCooperates => (record = "pending" ~> record \in Terminal)

Init ==
    /\ operation \in Operations
    /\ execution \in {"absent", "running", "success"}
    /\ record = "pending"
    /\ online = FALSE
    /\ recovering = TRUE
    /\ result = "none"
    /\ reason = "none"
    /\ request = "none"
    /\ starts = IF execution = "absent" THEN 0 ELSE 1
    /\ spool = TRUE
    /\ visible = (operation = "publish" /\ execution = "success")
    /\ hidden = IF operation = "copy"
                THEN CASE execution = "absent" -> "absent"
                       [] execution = "running" -> "partial"
                       [] OTHER -> "whole"
                ELSE IF execution = "success" THEN "absent" ELSE "verified"
    /\ compared = (operation = "publish")
    /\ targets = OwnNames
    /\ observed = FALSE

\* Replayed commands carry the SAME durable identity, and the caller deduplicates.
\* In the observation alternative, "absent" is authoritative: old work is fenced.
Drive ==
    /\ online
    /\ record = "pending"
    /\ \/ /\ recovering
          /\ request = "none"
          /\ result = "none"
          /\ request' = IF ReplayAllowed THEN "execute" ELSE "observe"
          /\ recovering' = ~ReplayAllowed
          /\ UNCHANGED <<operation, record, online, execution, result, reason,
              starts, spool, visible, hidden, compared, targets, observed>>
       \/ /\ ~ReplayAllowed
          /\ recovering
          /\ request = "none"
          /\ result \in {"absent", "running"}
          /\ recovering' = FALSE
          /\ observed' = TRUE
          /\ request' = IF result = "absent" THEN "execute" ELSE "none"
          /\ result' = "none"
          /\ UNCHANGED <<operation, record, online, execution, reason, starts,
              spool, visible, hidden, compared, targets>>
       \/ /\ result \in {"success"} \cup FailureReasons
          /\ record' = IF result = "success" THEN "success" ELSE "failed"
          /\ recovering' = FALSE
          /\ observed' = TRUE
          /\ request' = "none"
          /\ result' = "none"
          /\ UNCHANGED <<operation, online, execution, reason, starts,
              spool, visible, hidden, compared, targets>>

AcceptCommand ==
    /\ online
    /\ record = "pending"
    /\ request = "execute"
    /\ request' = "none"
    /\ execution' = IF execution = "absent" THEN "running" ELSE execution
    /\ starts' = IF execution = "absent" THEN starts + 1 ELSE starts
    /\ hidden' = IF execution = "absent" /\ operation = "copy"
                 THEN "partial" ELSE hidden
    /\ result' = CASE execution = "success" -> "success"
                   [] execution = "failed" -> reason
                   [] OTHER -> "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<operation, record, online, recovering, reason,
        spool, visible, compared, targets, observed>>

ObserveCommand ==
    /\ ~ReplayAllowed
    /\ online
    /\ record = "pending"
    /\ request = "observe"
    /\ request' = "none"
    /\ result' = IF execution = "failed" THEN reason ELSE execution
    /\ UNCHANGED <<operation, record, online, recovering, execution, reason,
        starts, spool, visible, hidden, compared, targets, observed>>

FinishCommand ==
    /\ execution = "running"
    /\ execution' = "success"
    /\ hidden' = IF operation = "copy" THEN "whole" ELSE "absent"
    /\ visible' = (operation = "publish")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<operation, record, online, recovering, result, reason,
        request, starts, spool, compared, targets, observed>>

FailCommand(why) ==
    /\ execution = "running"
    /\ execution' = "failed"
    /\ reason' = why
    /\ UNCHANGED <<operation, record, online, recovering, result,
        request, starts, spool, visible, hidden, compared, targets, observed>>

DeliverResult ==
    /\ online
    /\ record = "pending"
    /\ ~recovering
    /\ request = "none"
    /\ result = "none"
    /\ execution \in Terminal
    /\ result' = IF execution = "success" THEN "success" ELSE reason
    /\ UNCHANGED <<operation, record, online, recovering, execution, reason,
        request, starts, spool, visible, hidden, compared, targets, observed>>

Crash ==
    /\ online
    /\ online' = FALSE
    /\ recovering' = (record = "pending")
    /\ request' = "none"
    /\ result' = "none"
    /\ observed' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<operation, record, execution, reason, starts, spool,
        visible, hidden, compared, targets>>

Resume ==
    /\ ~online
    /\ online' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<operation, record, recovering, execution, result, reason,
        request, starts, spool, visible, hidden, compared, targets, observed>>

TerminalIdle == record \in Terminal /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ Drive
    \/ AcceptCommand
    \/ ObserveCommand
    \/ FinishCommand
    \/ \E why \in FailureReasons : FailCommand(why)
    \/ DeliverResult
    \/ Crash
    \/ Resume
    \/ TerminalIdle

\* The core allocates fresh work instead of recovering the existing command.
BlindRestart ==
    /\ online
    /\ record = "pending"
    /\ starts = 1
    /\ starts' = 2
    /\ UNCHANGED <<operation, record, online, recovering, execution, result,
        reason, request, spool, visible, hidden, compared, targets, observed>>

ChangeUnrelatedName ==
    /\ targets' = FolderNames
    /\ UNCHANGED <<operation, record, online, recovering, execution, result,
        reason, request, starts, spool, visible, hidden, compared, observed>>

CoreRuns == WF_vars(Drive)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
====

---- MODULE RecordingHandover ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Contents, FailureReasons
VARIABLES decision, query, report, content, online, compared, reason,
    spool, rewritten

vars == <<decision, query, report, content, online, compared, reason,
    spool, rewritten>>

\* This preview starts with an existing final name not attributable to this
\* hand-over. It decides the conflict only, not publication or spool cleanup.
\* A comparison reads the existing file; it grants no permission to replace it.
RejectExisting == TRUE

TypeOK ==
    /\ decision \in {"undecided", "reject", "reuse"}
    /\ query \in {"none", "compare"}
    /\ report \in {"none", "match", "different", "gone"}
    /\ content \in Contents
    /\ online \in BOOLEAN
    /\ compared \in BOOLEAN
    /\ reason \in {"none"} \cup FailureReasons
    /\ spool \in BOOLEAN
    /\ rewritten \in BOOLEAN

ExistingFileUntouched == ~rewritten

VerifiedReuse == decision = "reuse" => compared /\ content = "same"

RejectionKeepsSource ==
    decision = "reject" => spool /\ reason \in FailureReasons

NoAdoption == decision # "reuse"

NoConflictComparison == query = "none" /\ report = "none"

SourceRetained == spool

ConflictRejected == decision = "reject" /\ reason = "name-conflict"

IdenticalFileReused == decision = "reuse" /\ content = "same" /\ compared

DifferentFileRejected ==
    decision = "reject" /\ reason = "name-conflict" /\ content = "different"

MissingFolderReported == decision = "reject" /\ reason = "gone"

CallerResponds == query = "compare" /\ decision = "undecided" ~> report # "none"

ConflictTerminates ==
    (<>[]online /\ CallerResponds) =>
        (decision = "undecided" ~> decision \in {"reject", "reuse"})

Init ==
    /\ decision = "undecided"
    /\ query = "none"
    /\ report = "none"
    /\ content \in Contents
    /\ online = TRUE
    /\ compared = FALSE
    /\ reason = "none"
    /\ spool = TRUE
    /\ rewritten = FALSE

DecideConflict ==
    /\ online
    /\ decision = "undecided"
    /\ \/ /\ RejectExisting
          /\ decision' = "reject"
          /\ reason' = "name-conflict"
          /\ UNCHANGED <<query, report, content, online, compared, spool, rewritten>>
       \/ /\ ~RejectExisting
          /\ query = "none"
          /\ report = "none"
          /\ query' = "compare"
          /\ UNCHANGED <<decision, report, content, online, compared, reason,
              spool, rewritten>>
       \/ /\ ~RejectExisting
          /\ report = "match"
          /\ decision' = "reuse"
          /\ compared' = TRUE
          /\ query' = "none"
          /\ UNCHANGED <<report, content, online, reason, spool, rewritten>>
       \/ /\ ~RejectExisting
          /\ report \in {"different", "gone"}
          /\ decision' = "reject"
          /\ reason' = IF report = "different" THEN "name-conflict" ELSE "gone"
          /\ query' = "none"
          /\ UNCHANGED <<report, content, online, compared, spool, rewritten>>

CompareExisting ==
    /\ online
    /\ decision = "undecided"
    /\ query = "compare"
    /\ report = "none"
    /\ report' = IF content = "same" THEN "match" ELSE "different"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<decision, query, content, online, compared, reason, spool,
        rewritten>>

FolderUnavailable ==
    /\ online
    /\ decision = "undecided"
    /\ query = "compare"
    /\ report = "none"
    /\ report' = "gone"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<decision, query, content, online, compared, reason, spool,
        rewritten>>

Crash ==
    /\ online
    /\ online' = FALSE
    /\ report' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<decision, query, content, compared, reason, spool, rewritten>>

Resume ==
    /\ ~online
    /\ online' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<decision, query, report, content, compared, reason, spool,
        rewritten>>

TerminalIdle == decision # "undecided" /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ DecideConflict
    \/ CompareExisting
    \/ FolderUnavailable
    \/ Crash
    \/ Resume
    \/ TerminalIdle

OverwriteExisting ==
    /\ decision = "undecided"
    /\ rewritten' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<decision, query, report, content, online, compared, reason, spool>>

AdoptWithoutComparison ==
    /\ decision = "undecided"
    /\ ~compared
    /\ decision' = "reuse"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<query, report, content, online, compared, reason, spool, rewritten>>

CoreRuns == WF_vars(DecideConflict)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
====

---- MODULE RecordingHandover ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS RetryLimit, FailureReasons, FolderNames
VARIABLES phase, hidden, visible, verified, spool, mismatches, activeCopies,
    publications, reason, target, online, sawMismatch, retriedMismatch, retriedFailure, rejected

vars == <<phase, hidden, visible, verified, spool, mismatches, activeCopies,
    publications, reason, target, online, sawMismatch, retriedMismatch, retriedFailure, rejected>>

\* This preview handles conclusively resolved operation results for one recording
\* with initially vacant owned names. Lost results and name conflicts are separate
\* forks. File facts describe the caller; issuing a request does not copy bytes.
\* RetryLimit bounds a configurable policy in A. In B the counter saturates:
\* its value RetryLimit means at least that many mismatches, not a retry limit.
HiddenName == ".recording.pending"
FinalName == "recording.wav"
OwnNames == {HiddenName, FinalName}
Terminal == {"done", "failed"}
BoundedRetries == TRUE
SaturatingIncrement(n) == IF n < RetryLimit THEN n + 1 ELSE n

TypeOK ==
    /\ phase \in {"ready", "copying", "copied", "checking", "verified",
        "discard", "removing", "retry-decision", "publishing", "done", "failed"}
    /\ hidden \in {"absent", "partial", "same", "different"}
    /\ visible \in {"absent", "partial", "same", "different"}
    /\ verified \in BOOLEAN
    /\ spool \in BOOLEAN
    /\ mismatches \in 0..RetryLimit
    /\ activeCopies \in 0..2
    /\ publications \in 0..2
    /\ reason \in {"none", "mismatch-limit"} \cup FailureReasons
    /\ target \in {"none"} \cup FolderNames
    /\ online \in BOOLEAN
    /\ sawMismatch \in BOOLEAN
    /\ retriedMismatch \in BOOLEAN
    /\ retriedFailure \in BOOLEAN
    /\ rejected \in BOOLEAN

WholePublication == visible = "absent" \/ (visible = "same" /\ verified)

PublishedBeforeSourceRemoval == ~spool => visible = "same" /\ verified

VerifyBeforePublishRequest == phase = "publishing" => verified /\ hidden = "same"

OneCopyAtATime == activeCopies <= 1

OnePublication == publications <= 1

CopyUsesHiddenName == phase = "copying" => target = HiddenName

OwnedNamesOnly == target = "none" \/ target \in OwnNames

DiscardBeforeRecopy ==
    phase = "copying" => hidden \in {"absent", "partial"} /\ ~verified /\ ~rejected

FailureKeepsSource ==
    phase = "failed" => spool /\ reason \in FailureReasons \cup {"mismatch-limit"}

SourceRetained == spool

LimitStopsRetries ==
    mismatches = RetryLimit =>
        phase \notin {"ready", "copying", "copied", "checking", "verified", "publishing"}

NoMismatchFailure == reason # "mismatch-limit"

HandedOver == phase = "done" /\ visible = "same" /\ verified

BadCopyRemoved ==
    sawMismatch /\ hidden = "absent" /\ phase = "retry-decision"

BadCopyRetried == retriedMismatch /\ phase = "copying"

MissingFolderReported == phase = "failed" /\ reason = "gone" /\ spool

FullFolderReported == phase = "failed" /\ reason = "full" /\ spool

MismatchLimitReported ==
    phase = "failed" /\ reason = "mismatch-limit" /\ hidden = "absent" /\ spool

RetryBeyondCounterBound == mismatches = RetryLimit /\ phase = "copying"

FailedAttemptRetried == retriedFailure /\ phase = "copying"

CallerResponds ==
    /\ (phase = "copying" ~> phase # "copying")
    /\ (phase = "checking" ~> phase # "checking")
    /\ (phase = "removing" ~> phase # "removing")
    /\ (phase = "publishing" ~> phase # "publishing")

MismatchesEventuallyStop ==
    <>[](phase # "checking" \/ hidden = "same")

AttemptTerminates ==
    (<>[]online /\ CallerResponds /\
        (BoundedRetries \/ MismatchesEventuallyStop)) =>
        (phase \notin Terminal ~> phase \in Terminal)

Init ==
    /\ phase = "ready"
    /\ hidden = "absent"
    /\ visible = "absent"
    /\ verified = FALSE
    /\ spool = TRUE
    /\ mismatches = 0
    /\ activeCopies = 0
    /\ publications = 0
    /\ reason = "none"
    /\ target = "none"
    /\ online = TRUE
    /\ sawMismatch = FALSE
    /\ retriedMismatch = FALSE
    /\ retriedFailure = FALSE
    /\ rejected = FALSE

Decide ==
    /\ online
    /\ \/ /\ phase = "ready"
          /\ hidden = "absent"
          /\ activeCopies = 0
          /\ phase' = "copying"
          /\ activeCopies' = 1
          /\ target' = HiddenName
          /\ retriedMismatch' = (retriedMismatch \/ sawMismatch)
          /\ UNCHANGED <<hidden, visible, verified, spool, mismatches,
              publications, reason, online, sawMismatch, retriedFailure, rejected>>
       \/ /\ phase = "copied"
          /\ phase' = "checking"
          /\ target' = HiddenName
          /\ UNCHANGED <<hidden, visible, verified, spool, mismatches,
              activeCopies, publications, reason, online, sawMismatch,
              retriedMismatch, retriedFailure, rejected>>
       \/ /\ phase = "verified"
          /\ verified
          /\ hidden = "same"
          /\ phase' = "publishing"
          /\ target' = FinalName
          /\ UNCHANGED <<hidden, visible, verified, spool, mismatches,
              activeCopies, publications, reason, online, sawMismatch,
              retriedMismatch, retriedFailure, rejected>>
       \/ /\ phase = "discard"
          /\ phase' = "removing"
          /\ target' = HiddenName
          /\ UNCHANGED <<hidden, visible, verified, spool, mismatches,
              activeCopies, publications, reason, online, sawMismatch,
              retriedMismatch, retriedFailure, rejected>>
       \/ /\ phase = "retry-decision"
          /\ phase' = IF BoundedRetries /\ mismatches = RetryLimit
                      THEN "failed" ELSE "ready"
          /\ reason' = IF BoundedRetries /\ mismatches = RetryLimit
                       THEN "mismatch-limit" ELSE "none"
          /\ UNCHANGED <<hidden, visible, verified, spool, mismatches,
              activeCopies, publications, target, online, sawMismatch,
              retriedMismatch, retriedFailure, rejected>>

CopyPartial ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "copying"
    /\ hidden = "absent"
    /\ hidden' = "partial"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, visible, verified, spool, mismatches, activeCopies,
        publications, reason, target, online, sawMismatch, retriedMismatch,
        retriedFailure, rejected>>

CopyFinished(contents) ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "copying"
    /\ phase' = "copied"
    /\ hidden' = contents
    /\ activeCopies' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<visible, verified, spool, mismatches, publications, reason,
        target, online, sawMismatch, retriedMismatch, retriedFailure, rejected>>

ComparisonReported ==
    /\ online
    /\ rejected' = (hidden = "different")
    /\ phase = "checking"
    /\ phase' = IF hidden = "same" THEN "verified" ELSE "discard"
    /\ verified' = (hidden = "same")
    /\ mismatches' = IF hidden = "different"
                      THEN SaturatingIncrement(mismatches) ELSE mismatches
    /\ sawMismatch' = (sawMismatch \/ hidden = "different")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<hidden, visible, spool, activeCopies, publications, reason,
        target, online, retriedMismatch, retriedFailure>>

DiscardReported ==
    /\ online
    /\ rejected' = FALSE
    /\ phase = "removing"
    /\ phase' = "retry-decision"
    /\ hidden' = "absent"
    /\ verified' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<visible, spool, mismatches, activeCopies, publications,
        reason, target, online, sawMismatch, retriedMismatch, retriedFailure>>

PublicationReported ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "publishing"
    /\ verified
    /\ hidden = "same"
    /\ phase' = "done"
    /\ hidden' = "absent"
    /\ visible' = "same"
    /\ publications' = publications + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<verified, spool, mismatches, activeCopies, reason, target,
        online, sawMismatch, retriedMismatch, retriedFailure, rejected>>

FolderFailure(why) ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase \in {"copying", "checking", "removing", "publishing"}
    /\ phase' = "failed"
    /\ reason' = why
    /\ activeCopies' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<hidden, visible, verified, spool, mismatches, publications,
        target, online, sawMismatch, retriedMismatch, retriedFailure, rejected>>

RetryFailure ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "failed"
    /\ phase' = CASE hidden = "absent" -> "ready"
                  [] hidden = "same" -> "copied"
                  [] OTHER -> "discard"
    /\ reason' = "none"
    /\ mismatches' = 0
    /\ verified' = FALSE
    /\ retriedFailure' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<hidden, visible, spool, activeCopies, publications, target,
        online, sawMismatch, retriedMismatch, rejected>>

Crash ==
    /\ online
    /\ online' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, hidden, visible, verified, spool, mismatches,
        activeCopies, publications, reason, target, sawMismatch,
        retriedMismatch, retriedFailure, rejected>>

Resume ==
    /\ ~online
    /\ online' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, hidden, visible, verified, spool, mismatches,
        activeCopies, publications, reason, target, sawMismatch,
        retriedMismatch, retriedFailure, rejected>>

TerminalIdle == phase \in Terminal /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ Decide
    \/ CopyPartial
    \/ \E contents \in {"same", "different"} : CopyFinished(contents)
    \/ ComparisonReported
    \/ DiscardReported
    \/ PublicationReported
    \/ \E why \in FailureReasons : FolderFailure(why)
    \/ RetryFailure
    \/ Crash
    \/ Resume
    \/ TerminalIdle

PublishBeforeComparison ==
    /\ phase = "copied"
    /\ ~verified
    /\ phase' = "done"
    /\ visible' = hidden
    /\ hidden' = "absent"
    /\ publications' = publications + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<verified, spool, mismatches, activeCopies, reason, target,
        online, sawMismatch, retriedMismatch, retriedFailure, rejected>>

StartOverlappingCopy ==
    /\ phase = "copying"
    /\ activeCopies = 1
    /\ activeCopies' = 2
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, hidden, visible, verified, spool, mismatches,
        publications, reason, target, online, sawMismatch, retriedMismatch,
        retriedFailure, rejected>>

RemoveBeforePublication ==
    /\ phase = "copying"
    /\ spool' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, hidden, visible, verified, mismatches, activeCopies,
        publications, reason, target, online, sawMismatch, retriedMismatch,
        retriedFailure, rejected>>

---- MODULE RecordingHandover ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS RetryLimit, FailureReasons, FolderNames
VARIABLES phase, hidden, visible, verified, spool, mismatches, activeCopies,
    publications, reason, target, online, sawMismatch, retriedMismatch, retriedFailure, rejected

vars == <<phase, hidden, visible, verified, spool, mismatches, activeCopies,
    publications, reason, target, online, sawMismatch, retriedMismatch, retriedFailure, rejected>>

\* This preview handles conclusively resolved operation results for one recording
\* with initially vacant owned names. Lost results and name conflicts are separate
\* forks. File facts describe the caller; issuing a request does not copy bytes.
\* RetryLimit bounds a configurable policy in A. In B the counter saturates:
\* its value RetryLimit means at least that many mismatches, not a retry limit.
HiddenName == ".recording.pending"
FinalName == "recording.wav"
OwnNames == {HiddenName, FinalName}
Terminal == {"done", "failed"}
BoundedRetries == FALSE
SaturatingIncrement(n) == IF n < RetryLimit THEN n + 1 ELSE n

TypeOK ==
    /\ phase \in {"ready", "copying", "copied", "checking", "verified",
        "discard", "removing", "retry-decision", "publishing", "done", "failed"}
    /\ hidden \in {"absent", "partial", "same", "different"}
    /\ visible \in {"absent", "partial", "same", "different"}
    /\ verified \in BOOLEAN
    /\ spool \in BOOLEAN
    /\ mismatches \in 0..RetryLimit
    /\ activeCopies \in 0..2
    /\ publications \in 0..2
    /\ reason \in {"none", "mismatch-limit"} \cup FailureReasons
    /\ target \in {"none"} \cup FolderNames
    /\ online \in BOOLEAN
    /\ sawMismatch \in BOOLEAN
    /\ retriedMismatch \in BOOLEAN
    /\ retriedFailure \in BOOLEAN
    /\ rejected \in BOOLEAN

WholePublication == visible = "absent" \/ (visible = "same" /\ verified)

PublishedBeforeSourceRemoval == ~spool => visible = "same" /\ verified

VerifyBeforePublishRequest == phase = "publishing" => verified /\ hidden = "same"

OneCopyAtATime == activeCopies <= 1

OnePublication == publications <= 1

CopyUsesHiddenName == phase = "copying" => target = HiddenName

OwnedNamesOnly == target = "none" \/ target \in OwnNames

DiscardBeforeRecopy ==
    phase = "copying" => hidden \in {"absent", "partial"} /\ ~verified /\ ~rejected

FailureKeepsSource ==
    phase = "failed" => spool /\ reason \in FailureReasons \cup {"mismatch-limit"}

SourceRetained == spool

LimitStopsRetries ==
    mismatches = RetryLimit =>
        phase \notin {"ready", "copying", "copied", "checking", "verified", "publishing"}

NoMismatchFailure == reason # "mismatch-limit"

HandedOver == phase = "done" /\ visible = "same" /\ verified

BadCopyRemoved ==
    sawMismatch /\ hidden = "absent" /\ phase = "retry-decision"

BadCopyRetried == retriedMismatch /\ phase = "copying"

MissingFolderReported == phase = "failed" /\ reason = "gone" /\ spool

FullFolderReported == phase = "failed" /\ reason = "full" /\ spool

MismatchLimitReported ==
    phase = "failed" /\ reason = "mismatch-limit" /\ hidden = "absent" /\ spool

RetryBeyondCounterBound == mismatches = RetryLimit /\ phase = "copying"

FailedAttemptRetried == retriedFailure /\ phase = "copying"

CallerResponds ==
    /\ (phase = "copying" ~> phase # "copying")
    /\ (phase = "checking" ~> phase # "checking")
    /\ (phase = "removing" ~> phase # "removing")
    /\ (phase = "publishing" ~> phase # "publishing")

MismatchesEventuallyStop ==
    <>[](phase # "checking" \/ hidden = "same")

AttemptTerminates ==
    (<>[]online /\ CallerResponds /\
        (BoundedRetries \/ MismatchesEventuallyStop)) =>
        (phase \notin Terminal ~> phase \in Terminal)

Init ==
    /\ phase = "ready"
    /\ hidden = "absent"
    /\ visible = "absent"
    /\ verified = FALSE
    /\ spool = TRUE
    /\ mismatches = 0
    /\ activeCopies = 0
    /\ publications = 0
    /\ reason = "none"
    /\ target = "none"
    /\ online = TRUE
    /\ sawMismatch = FALSE
    /\ retriedMismatch = FALSE
    /\ retriedFailure = FALSE
    /\ rejected = FALSE

Decide ==
    /\ online
    /\ \/ /\ phase = "ready"
          /\ hidden = "absent"
          /\ activeCopies = 0
          /\ phase' = "copying"
          /\ activeCopies' = 1
          /\ target' = HiddenName
          /\ retriedMismatch' = (retriedMismatch \/ sawMismatch)
          /\ UNCHANGED <<hidden, visible, verified, spool, mismatches,
              publications, reason, online, sawMismatch, retriedFailure, rejected>>
       \/ /\ phase = "copied"
          /\ phase' = "checking"
          /\ target' = HiddenName
          /\ UNCHANGED <<hidden, visible, verified, spool, mismatches,
              activeCopies, publications, reason, online, sawMismatch,
              retriedMismatch, retriedFailure, rejected>>
       \/ /\ phase = "verified"
          /\ verified
          /\ hidden = "same"
          /\ phase' = "publishing"
          /\ target' = FinalName
          /\ UNCHANGED <<hidden, visible, verified, spool, mismatches,
              activeCopies, publications, reason, online, sawMismatch,
              retriedMismatch, retriedFailure, rejected>>
       \/ /\ phase = "discard"
          /\ phase' = "removing"
          /\ target' = HiddenName
          /\ UNCHANGED <<hidden, visible, verified, spool, mismatches,
              activeCopies, publications, reason, online, sawMismatch,
              retriedMismatch, retriedFailure, rejected>>
       \/ /\ phase = "retry-decision"
          /\ phase' = IF BoundedRetries /\ mismatches = RetryLimit
                      THEN "failed" ELSE "ready"
          /\ reason' = IF BoundedRetries /\ mismatches = RetryLimit
                       THEN "mismatch-limit" ELSE "none"
          /\ UNCHANGED <<hidden, visible, verified, spool, mismatches,
              activeCopies, publications, target, online, sawMismatch,
              retriedMismatch, retriedFailure, rejected>>

CopyPartial ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "copying"
    /\ hidden = "absent"
    /\ hidden' = "partial"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, visible, verified, spool, mismatches, activeCopies,
        publications, reason, target, online, sawMismatch, retriedMismatch,
        retriedFailure, rejected>>

CopyFinished(contents) ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "copying"
    /\ phase' = "copied"
    /\ hidden' = contents
    /\ activeCopies' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<visible, verified, spool, mismatches, publications, reason,
        target, online, sawMismatch, retriedMismatch, retriedFailure, rejected>>

ComparisonReported ==
    /\ online
    /\ rejected' = (hidden = "different")
    /\ phase = "checking"
    /\ phase' = IF hidden = "same" THEN "verified" ELSE "discard"
    /\ verified' = (hidden = "same")
    /\ mismatches' = IF hidden = "different"
                      THEN SaturatingIncrement(mismatches) ELSE mismatches
    /\ sawMismatch' = (sawMismatch \/ hidden = "different")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<hidden, visible, spool, activeCopies, publications, reason,
        target, online, retriedMismatch, retriedFailure>>

DiscardReported ==
    /\ online
    /\ rejected' = FALSE
    /\ phase = "removing"
    /\ phase' = "retry-decision"
    /\ hidden' = "absent"
    /\ verified' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<visible, spool, mismatches, activeCopies, publications,
        reason, target, online, sawMismatch, retriedMismatch, retriedFailure>>

PublicationReported ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "publishing"
    /\ verified
    /\ hidden = "same"
    /\ phase' = "done"
    /\ hidden' = "absent"
    /\ visible' = "same"
    /\ publications' = publications + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<verified, spool, mismatches, activeCopies, reason, target,
        online, sawMismatch, retriedMismatch, retriedFailure, rejected>>

FolderFailure(why) ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase \in {"copying", "checking", "removing", "publishing"}
    /\ phase' = "failed"
    /\ reason' = why
    /\ activeCopies' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<hidden, visible, verified, spool, mismatches, publications,
        target, online, sawMismatch, retriedMismatch, retriedFailure, rejected>>

RetryFailure ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "failed"
    /\ phase' = CASE hidden = "absent" -> "ready"
                  [] hidden = "same" -> "copied"
                  [] OTHER -> "discard"
    /\ reason' = "none"
    /\ mismatches' = 0
    /\ verified' = FALSE
    /\ retriedFailure' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<hidden, visible, spool, activeCopies, publications, target,
        online, sawMismatch, retriedMismatch, rejected>>

Crash ==
    /\ online
    /\ online' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, hidden, visible, verified, spool, mismatches,
        activeCopies, publications, reason, target, sawMismatch,
        retriedMismatch, retriedFailure, rejected>>

Resume ==
    /\ ~online
    /\ online' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, hidden, visible, verified, spool, mismatches,
        activeCopies, publications, reason, target, sawMismatch,
        retriedMismatch, retriedFailure, rejected>>

TerminalIdle == phase \in Terminal /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ Decide
    \/ CopyPartial
    \/ \E contents \in {"same", "different"} : CopyFinished(contents)
    \/ ComparisonReported
    \/ DiscardReported
    \/ PublicationReported
    \/ \E why \in FailureReasons : FolderFailure(why)
    \/ RetryFailure
    \/ Crash
    \/ Resume
    \/ TerminalIdle

PublishBeforeComparison ==
    /\ phase = "copied"
    /\ ~verified
    /\ phase' = "done"
    /\ visible' = hidden
    /\ hidden' = "absent"
    /\ publications' = publications + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<verified, spool, mismatches, activeCopies, reason, target,
        online, sawMismatch, retriedMismatch, retriedFailure, rejected>>

StartOverlappingCopy ==
    /\ phase = "copying"
    /\ activeCopies = 1
    /\ activeCopies' = 2
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, hidden, visible, verified, spool, mismatches,
        publications, reason, target, online, sawMismatch, retriedMismatch,
        retriedFailure, rejected>>

RemoveBeforePublication ==
    /\ phase = "copying"
    /\ spool' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, hidden, visible, verified, mismatches, activeCopies,
        publications, reason, target, online, sawMismatch, retriedMismatch,
        retriedFailure, rejected>>
